what: Generated by tools/vehicles/review/build.mjs from art/vehicles/*/vehicle.json: every roster vehicle, no hard-coded list.

vehicles.name: AU Hawk
vehicles.summary: The lower undertray is separated from arch-raised side lips, removing the curved radial underside ramps. Raised painted door moulding, tucked flanks and the reference spoiler improve the shaded body. Hawk-style atlas wheels retain broad silver five-spoke faces with sealed inner sidewalls; windscreen/backlight detail uses the existing atlas. Exported triangles are 2096 / 880 / 600 within unchanged 3000 / 900 / 600 budgets. Weighted silhouette scores are 0.9595 / 0.9579 / 0.9510; the LOD2 top view remains 0.9377. Original physical contracts, pivots, colliders, anchors and handling are unchanged. Named corrective checks pass; grille/bumper recess depth and lamp/mirror detail remain coarser than the reference. This is awaiting artistic review, not full production qualification.

vehicles.name: Cruz Missile
vehicles.summary: Owner panel follow-up: fuller door waist and tucked sill, curved nudge rails with brackets penetrating the actual fascia, thick conforming splitter and closed atlas wheels. Independent level undertray and inner well walls remove the arch-to-centre floor fans. Hawk-style wheel detail saves 96 LOD0 triangles and funds the repaired volume. Intact triangles 2052 / 897 / 590, within unchanged 2800 / 900 / 600. Collider/sidecar/profile bytes and hinges are unchanged. Shaded comparisons inspected; generated-reference lighting and fine accessories remain approximate, not an owner likeness acceptance.

vehicles.name: Hawk Dash
vehicles.summary: Third likeness pass: wider lower stance, body widening starts lower, sloping shoulders above the wheels, narrower upper cabin, and a rounded nose in plan. Lamps sit closer to the reference shapes and heights; exhaust outlets are closer together. Cheap wheels retained; triangles 2702 / 879 / 597 within 2800 / 900 / 600. New reference-derived tests check local width, shoulder slope, nose taper, lamps/outlets and camera setup at every LOD. Collision hulls and handling retained.

specTwin.sharedSpec: One spec, two bodies (R123): the Hawk Dash and the Lion President name spec 'aussie-v8' in web/shared/src/roster.json, and their profiles' handling (tuning) is identical, held by tools/vehicles/test/spec-twins.test.mjs. Rear drive, 1700 kg, Cruz-like launch, more power per kilo for a higher top speed; the bodies (hull, wheels, damage parts) are each car's own.

vehicles.name: Lion President
vehicles.summary: The undertray no longer fans up to the wheel arches. A lower-door return, separate shoulder rollover and inset bay liner restore panel volume; lamp and bumper-corner graphics clip to the real side facets. Coarse tiers retain a straight connected lower sill. Hawk-style atlas wheels have sealed inner sidewalls, and glass detail adds no geometry or material. Exported triangles are 2321 / 892 / 564 within unchanged 2400 / 900 / 600 budgets. Named corrective checks pass, while weighted silhouette scores 0.9461 / 0.9400 / 0.9443 remain below the approximately 0.95 target. Physical contracts, pivots, colliders, anchors and handling are unchanged. Fascia recess depth and lamp/mirror detail remain coarser than the reference; this is an awaiting-review candidate with the global likeness target unmet.

vehicles.name: Pig Catcher
vehicles.summary: Replaced flat radiator plates and rear leaves with convex panels and explicit crests. Raised both round spotlights above the beak instead of hiding them behind it. Split the engine into a smaller crankcase, tapered cylinder and real cooling ribs; tapered trousers with overlapping knee joints, connected the neck, added shirt collar/placket/pockets. Replaced bar spokes with narrow open wires and removed buried tread faces. Baked triangles 2595 / 898 / 599; unchanged physics/sidecar. Global silhouette scores 0.8451 / 0.8226 / 0.7978 remain below ~.95; review candidate with remaining shaded mismatches documented. Coarse tyres now retain twelve outer stations and eight vertices around the open rim hole. Hidden joined caps, buried panel backs and fender undersides funded the round silhouette without changing LOD0.

vehicles.name: Postie Bike
vehicles.summary: Split both cream tank inserts on their actual finished facet diagonals; removed the spikes that escaped the red shell in the hero view. Reduced the crankcase casting, opened cooling fins, tapered shorts and shins, joined the neck to the collar/shell and removed a floating black helmet disc. Added collar/vest creases. Thin open wire spokes retain wheel daylight. Baked triangles 2611 / 899 / 599; unchanged physics/sidecar. Global silhouette scores 0.8492 / 0.8256 / 0.7944 remain below ~.95; review candidate with remaining shaded mismatches documented. Coarse tyres now retain twelve outer stations. The low-tier helmet now uses eight circumferential segments and four latitude bands; merged pannier masses and lean frame tubes funded the broad form.

vehicles.name: Tradie Ute
vehicles.summary: Shaded owner-photo review retains the convex lower doors, inset shoulder/glass, crowned cab roof and owner-tape tray/canopy. The curved centre-to-arch underside membrane is replaced by an independent straight central undertray, narrow arch returns and dark inner wheel wells. Rear lamp triplets now match the photo: amber outside, red centre, white inside. Coarse mirror attachment faces buried in the cab are removed; redundant LOD1 barrel discs and tapered LOD2 mirror mounts fund fully closed tyres at every tier. Flat spokes and the faceted profile remain; coarsest rims use a tiny neutral alloy glint. Physics, hinges, pivots, anchors, collision buffers and one paint-key material are frozen. Front styling and precise cab curvature remain estimates because local photos are dark rear obliques.
